title: 1959 AHSME Problem 46

solutions.text:
There are \(d-6\) rainy mornings and \(d-5\) rainy afternoons. By condition \((2),\) these are distinct rainy occasions, and their total is \(7.\) Hence \[ (d-6)+(d-5)=7, \] so \(2d=18\) and \(d=9.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Count rainy mornings and rainy afternoons from the numbers of clear half-days
Condition \((2)\) ensures that a rainy afternoon and rainy morning never occur on the same day
